run_choices_logprob: run choices_logprob to generate a tool choice from a set of options and print the result
run_batch_choices_logprob: run choices_logprob in batch mode with multiple questions and print each choice result
get_choice_logprobs: get logprobs metadata for each choice option from a state's generated field
define_sgl_function: define an sgl function with choices to constrain LLM generation to a fixed set of options
set_runtime_backend: set the default sglang runtime backend endpoint for LLM inference calls
